description: DocSifter benchmark corpus for Chinese technical documentation review. Each case pairs an input sentence with the expected reviewed output. Cases where expected equals text are negative samples that must NOT be modified. Cases noted paired-plain / paired-tech come in pairs that differ only by one technical token, so guards that skip technically dense text are measurable.
